entries.284a2552d7b78ab9: The company and four consolidated subsidiaries, one unconsolidated subsidiary and one affiliate make up the group, which operates membership-based sports clubs and related businesses. The reportable segment is a single segment, the Sports Club Management Business. As of March 31, 2026, the number of stores was 257 in total, comprising 187 directly operated stores and 70 stores under operating contracts; consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥48,865 million, and the consolidated number of employees was 890. In the United States, a consolidated subsidiary operates a membership golf club.

entries.83d651497244b4b0: As its management philosophy, the company states “Contributing to lifelong health from age 0,” and, toward realizing “Becoming the ideal wellness company,” it focuses on strengthening customer service, instructional ability and facility cleanliness, and strives for safe, secure and comfortable facility operations. In addition to improving profitability of the sports club management business, centered on the school and fitness businesses which are its core businesses, the company intends to expand revenue opportunities through new value creation, including further expansion of various sports and entertainment businesses, tourism business and online services, and business development in cooperation with the regional and education fields.
entries.84b2f54e8774cad3: In the current consolidated fiscal year, the company advanced facility renewals at existing stores and worked on acquiring new members, improving retention rates of existing members, and preventing cancellations. It also actively held sports and entertainment events, such as circuit coaching for athlete courses, its original body contest, and fitness live events, and works to improve customer satisfaction.
entries.8637c27e18cac5c2: This division consists mainly of travel business income sold to members, facility rental income from leasing the company's own facilities, external sales income and other operating income (excluding contracted-operation stores), etc.
entries.86e20175977cb8b6: The company's group is a single segment, the Sports Club Management Business, and sales by division for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥23,602 million for the Fitness Division, ¥14,790 million for the School Division, ¥7,050 million for the Commissioned Operations Division, ¥1,246 million for the Pro Shop Division and ¥2,175 million for Other. Because sales to external customers in Japan exceed 90% of consolidated net sales, sales by region are not disclosed, and there are no major customers accounting for 10% or more of sales. The management policy states that the fitness industry as a whole is on a recovery trend, supported by the expansion of small-format stores and rising health consciousness.

entries.af406305870857b8: Since its founding in 1969, it has been an industry pioneer in operating membership sports clubs and has a nationwide network of 257 stores, comprising 187 directly operated stores and 70 commissioned-operation stores. In addition to its record of running schools since opening its first swimming school in 1970, it has a track record of commissioned operations including 56 public sports facilities, and it also has a record of athlete development, with athletes belonging to the company winning medals at the Olympics.
